meta.title: Report a concern about a child
meta.description: Tell Friends of Animals about a worry for a child’s safety. You don’t need an account, and you can stay anonymous.

safeguardingReport.title: Report a concern about a child
safeguardingReport.lead: You don’t need an account, and you can stay anonymous. Only our safeguarding lead reads what you send.

danger.title: Is a child in danger right now?
danger.body: Call <emergency>112</emergency> first. You can call Childline on <childline>1098</childline> at any time, for free.

images.title: Pictures and videos
images.body: Please don’t send pictures or videos of a child being hurt. Report them at <cyberSite>cybercrime.gov.in</cyberSite> or call <cyberLine>1930</cyberLine>.

options.suspected_abuse: Someone may be hurting a child
options.inappropriate_contact: An adult contacting a child in a way that isn’t right
options.privacy_exposure: A child’s details or photo shown where they shouldn’t be

description.label: What happened, or what worries you?
description.hint: Say what you saw or heard, when and where, in your own words.
description.error: Tell us what happened, in up to 5,000 characters.

subjectDetails.label: Who is the child? (optional)
subjectDetails.hint: A first name, school, class or username helps us find them.

subjectAge.label: How old is the child? (optional)
subjectAge.age: {age, plural, =0 {Under 1} one {# year old} other {# years old}}
subjectAge.error: Choose an age under 18, or “I don’t know”.

anonymous.label: Keep me anonymous
anonymous.hint: We won’t know who you are, so we can’t reply to you.

reporterContact.label: Your email or phone (optional)
reporterContact.hint: Only our safeguarding lead sees it, to ask you more if they need to.

form.privacy: What you send is kept private and stored securely.

alerts.human_check_failed: We couldn’t check that a person sent this, so your report wasn’t sent. Please press Send report again.
alerts.rate_limited: Too many reports came from this connection in the last hour, so this one wasn’t sent. Please try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}, or get help now.
alerts.failed: Something went wrong, so your report wasn’t sent. Please press Send report again, or get help now.

help.title: Get help now
help.childline: Childline: call <childline>1098</childline>, free, at any time.

meta.title: Report sent
meta.description: Your safeguarding report reached Friends of Animals.

sent.title: Thank you for telling us
sent.lead: Your report reached our safeguarding lead. You did the right thing.
sent.next: Our safeguarding lead reads every report and decides what to do. If you left a way to reach you, they may get in touch.
sent.danger: If a child is in danger now, call <emergency>112</emergency>.
